5f8dcc21211a3d4e3a7a5ca366b469fb88117f61 ""page-allocator: split per-cpu
list into one-list-per-migrate-type"" has been returning MIGRATE_RESERVE
pages to the MIGRATE_MOVABLE free_list: in some sense depleting reserves.
Fix that in the most straightforward way (which
of alternative approaches
column2: is Mel's preference): the right migratetype is

column1: already in page_private(page)
How did this bug show up?  As a 20% slowdown in my tmpfs loop kbuild
swapping tests
column2: on PowerMac G5 with SLUB allocator.  Bisecting to that

column1: commit was easy
column2: but explaining the magnitude of the slowdown not easy.

column1: The same effect appears
less markedly on other machines (the PowerMac divides into fewer zones
than x86
column2: I think that may be a factor).  We guess that lumpy reclaim

column1: of short-lived high-order pages is implicated in some way
this bug has been tickling a poor decision somewhere in page reclaim.
But instrumentation hasn't told me much
column2: I've run out of time and

column1: imagination to determine exactly what's going on
the fix any longer: it's valid
column2: and might even fix other misbehaviours.
